TenantVault.title: TenantVault
TenantVault.description: Server-side secure metadata and token vault for cafe tenants. Accessible strictly via serverless backend with Firebase Admin SDK; direct client access is denied.

ownerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the cafe owner

encryptedRefreshToken.description: AES-256-GCM encrypted Google Drive OAuth refresh token

driveFolderId.description: Google Drive folder ID of NextGenGaming_Cafe_Data

driveFileId.description: Google Drive file ID of cafe_database.json

updatedAt.description: ISO timestamp of the last vault record update

ownerEmail.description: Email address of the business owner

WorkerBinding.title: WorkerBinding
WorkerBinding.description: Server-authoritative mapping of worker accounts to their owner businessId.

workerUid.description: Firebase Auth UID of the worker

businessId.description: Business tenant ID the worker belongs to

createdAt.description: ISO timestamp when the worker was bound

SystemConfig.title: SystemConfig
SystemConfig.description: Public system status indicating if the single Owner account has been configured.

ownerConfigured.description: Whether the owner has set up the cafe
